title: Harmonizing output imbalance for defect segmentation on extremely-imbalanced photovoltaic module cells images
mechanism: Focal loss with separate FP and FN regulators plus a region term (DIBE), and an output imbalance index (OII) that picks the regulators so the FP/FN balance at inference hits a target; built for tiny hidden cracks at 1:2000.
adaptation: Apply to the crack channel only; compute OII on val with 2 px tolerant TP/FP/FN instead of strict pixels, and raise the FN weight because relR@2 0.866 lags relP@2 0.930.
min_experiment: Arm: house with DIBE crack term. Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metric: test relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.92. Kill if relR@2 gain < 0.015.
evidence: R: four architectures, four datasets of varying imbalance, outperforms CE/Dice/focal/Tversky compounds (numbers not extracted).
prior_overlap: none: focal / Tversky families listed as untested; offset-tolerant CE n.d. is a different mechanism.

alt_notes.adaptation: Closest domain (mono PV cells, tiny hidden cracks): replace soft Dice on crack with DIBE_Reg, beta > alpha to push relR@2 toward 0.90 at relP@2 >= 0.90; pick alpha/beta by OII on val instead of a post-hoc logit bias.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house with DIBE_Reg (alpha 0.3, beta 0.7) on crack; baseline: house with val-chosen logit bias; metric: test/CV relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90; kill if gain < +0.02.
